newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Continental Mariner issues new shares.
newsitem.headline: Continental Mariner issues new shares.

text.p: Continental Mariner Investment Co Ltd said in a statement on Tuesday that it would issue 87.24 million shares to its controlling shareholder Source Holdings Ltd at HK$3.60 per share, raising about HK$311 million.

The company said in a statement that Source had also agreed to place 41.05 million existing Continental Mariner shares, or 9.41 percent of the existing issued share capital, with professional and institutional investors at HK$3.60 per share.
Continental Mariner said proceeds would be used for working capital and it had no present intention of acquiring any assets which would constitute a notifiable transaction.
The company said it would be responsible for all expenses incurred by Source, estimated at about HK$3.0 million.
Source's stake of 52.95 percent of Continental Mariner's issued share capital would remain unchanged following the transaction.
Shares in Continental Mariner, a shipping and investment holding company, closed at HK$4.125 on Monday.
